title: Traditional Canadian Tourtière
description: A hearty French-Canadian meat pie traditionally served during the Christmas season. This tourtière recipe features ground pork and beef, mixed with spices and vegetables, all wrapped in a flaky crust.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the ground pork and beef over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer pink.
Add the chopped onion, salt, black pepper, allspice, and cinnamon to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch pie dish and trim the edges to fit.
Fill the pie crust with the meat mixture and spread it out evenly.
Roll out the remaining pastry to fit the top of the pie and crimp the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake the tourtière for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Let the tourtière rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
